purpose: Retrieval and comparison only; no adjudication or application-data edits.

method.retrieval: Direct HTTP, sequential requests with 1.6-second pauses; raw replay preferred. Redirect destinations and capture timestamps recorded.
method.comparison: Current origin/main at the pinned base is the stored comparator. Historical brief passages are distinguished when already changed. Whitespace and markup boundaries are normalized for text-layer comparison; substantive wording and typography differences are reported.
method.hashBasis: SHA-256 of HTTP response bytes after content decompression. Raw temporary responses are not committed.
method.limits: Blocked means a response or connection prevented reading; not found means an accessible index or document did not contain the target. No human editorial acceptance. Capture dates do not establish publication dates.
method.absence: For the four stored Meta absence cells, match means this bounded rereading agrees with the existing comparison question; no universal absence or lack of contradiction is inferred.
method.typography: Quotation-span checks normalize whitespace and Unicode compatibility forms for PDF/text layout. Source wording is preserved in observed passages; editorial field joins, ellipses and bounded-search summaries are explicitly labelled.
